messages:
Maria (CS): Heads-up 1: we need coverage for the Hypercare enablement sessions next week across regions. Customers: NovaHealth (onboarding), Kitemed (dedicated migration), Lumina (renewal-watch). Aim: 2 facilitators + 1 engineering floater per session. Availability?
Raj (Solutions): I can cover EMEA Tue 13:00-14:30 UTC. Will prep the migration checklist for Kitemed.
Liam (Enablement): I'll take APAC Wed 22:00-23:30 UTC. Labs ready, added quantization notes to the deck: https://confluence.redwood/enablement/hypercare-labs
Olivia (Support): I can do NA Mon 09:00-10:30 UTC. For Lumina, they flagged HSM/KMS questions and SLA clarifications 1: we should add a 15min pre-call.
Ben (Platform): I can float for the APAC slot to help with perf/troubleshooting. If the lab setup fails I'll jump in. :thumbsup:
Maria (CS): Good. Quick draft agenda below, keep it tight (90m max):
```
- 0:00 Welcome + intros (5m)
- 0:05 Customer goals & blockers (15m)
- 0:20 Guided migration/demo (40m)
- 1:00 Breakout / hands-on lab (20m)
- 1:20 Action items + follow-ups (10m)
```
Raj (Solutions): Suggest adding a 5m "rollback & fallback" checklist during the demo for migration customers.
Liam (Enablement): Agree — add as quick slide after demo. Also I'll publish a slim docker image to speed lab setup. Ben, can you push the image to the internal registry?
Ben (Platform): I'll build & push slim image by EOD today. I'll post the image tag in the event notes.
Olivia (Support): For Lumina pre-call: Tue 12:30 UTC with @Raj and @Olivia. I'll update their ticket to mark "renewal-risk" and attach the agenda.
Maria (CS): I'll create calendar events and include the checklist + feedback form link. Feedback form will be 2 quick questions + 1 NPS.
OnboardBot: Calendar invites created and sent to participants and customers.
Liam (Enablement): Quick reminder 1: APAC lab uses GPU quota. Please confirm quotas for the region so we don't hit limits during hands-on.
Ben (Platform): Noted 1: I'll reserve a small burst pool for Wed APAC and confirm in the event notes.
Maria (CS): Final roster:
- Mon 09:00-10:30 UTC (NA) 1: Maria + Olivia
- Tue 13:00-14:30 UTC (EMEA) 1: Raj + Maria (pre-call Tue 12:30 UTC for Lumina)
- Wed 22:00-23:30 UTC (APAC) 1: Liam + Ben (floater)
Action items recap:
- Maria: send invites + feedback form link (today)
- Raj: prep KMS/HSM mapping doc + join Lumina pre-call
- Olivia: update customer tickets and run pre-call
- Liam: finalize APAC lab + share lab URL
- Ben: publish slim docker image + reserve burst pool
Everyone: add customer-specific notes to the calendar events.
Raj (Solutions): I'll attach the Kitemed migration checklist and the rollback slide.
Olivia (Support): Updating tickets now and tagging @account-team.
Maria (CS): I'll lock and send invites in 30m unless any conflicts. Thanks! :raised_hands:
